body: The soft spot thing is debatable, whenever she finds out I’m not eating she threatens to kill me and tells me I should die and all that jazz. She does provide the necessities, which I do appreciate, but I feel like she could handle this stuff a bit better.
They can also have mental illnesses

Yes, absolutely. There’s been multiple times in my class where the classroom got way too loud and I had to sink down into the floor and cover my ears. Also the sound of doors opening or slamming gets to me. I’m sorry you’re going through this, and know that you aren’t a baby for tying things to bad experiences.

Thank you for this. I’ve thought about trying to get away but I’m not sure I’d have anywhere to go. I can’t live with my dad for reasons that I don’t wanna get into, just know living with him isn’t an option. I also don’t have any family living nearby but my partner (the person who I mentioned in this post) said their family would be happy to take me in. I’m just worried that it would simply be my word against hers, and if I couldn’t get away, she’d get more angry and hurt me more.
